name: QE Soundboard — Act 2: Deja Vu
description: Click a sound to play it for everyone.

sounds.name: SFX: wristphone chirping in the dark
Read-aloud: waking up at Clockwork's
sounds.description: [groggy, low] Something is chirping. [pause] Your skull answers it with a pulse of pure misery. [beat] Dark room. Concrete floor. Crates. A smell of spilled beer and cleaning fluid. [sighs] Last night comes back in pieces... the orange-haired bartender, the little screen on his medallion looping some old ultraviolent film, round after round of something he called Rippers. [pause] [dry] You did celebrate. Thoroughly. [beat] The chirping is your wristphone. Somewhere under you.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: we have a problem
sounds.description: [nervous, too quick] Chummer. Good. You're alive. [beat] Listen... [exhales] we have a bit of a problem. [fidgeting] MegaMedia knows. [pause] About Euphoria. The first time. Don't ask me how, street ears, somebody talked... [beat] They know it was us.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: meet Carrone at eleven
sounds.description: [trying to sound calm] So far they're being... civilized. [beat] They want your team at Pacific Towers. The lobby. Eleven this morning. [pause] A man named Robert Carrone, her manager. [pleading] At least hear what he has to say.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: give them the employers
sounds.description: [lower, conspiratorial] And chummer? [beat] I get the feeling they'd forget the whole thing... if you had something to tell them about the people who hired us. [pause] [quickly] I'll be in touch. Eleven. Don't be late.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: second call (they didn't show)
sounds.description: [panicked, hushed] Where are you?! [breathing hard] It's past eleven! [beat] They're not asking nicely anymore, chummer. [desperate] Please. Go and see the man. [pause] Please.

sounds.name: SFX: lights on, the storeroom door opens
Clockwork: closing time, out you go
sounds.description: [cheerfully loud] Rise and shine, my lovelies! [laughs] Sleep well on me crates, did we? [beat] Right. Bar's closed, cleaner's due, and you lot are cluttering up my stock. [mock-polite] Out the back, if you please. Mind the empties.

sounds.name: Clockwork: the music
sounds.description: [delighted, over the music] Hear that? [humming along] The Ninth! [beat] Nothing clears a head like a full orchestra, mate. [laughs] Come back soon. Bring money.

sounds.name: Knight Errant: the pickup (they refused)
sounds.description: [flat, polite, final] Good morning. MegaMedia would like a word. [beat] You can walk to the car. [pause] Or we can help you.
